reference.title: The use of quartz as an internal pressure standard in high-pressure crystallography

methods.notes: Angel et al.'s room-temperature BM3 has V0=112.981(2) A^3, K0=37.12(9) GPa, and K0'=5.99(4).

recalculation.notes: Every simultaneously measured quartz conventional-cell volume and standard deviation is bundled. Using the run's 0.0001 GPa quartz volume as V0 and the Angel et al. K0 and K0' reproduces the printed pressures to 0.0067 GPa maximum residual; this run normalization removes the ambient cell-volume offset while retaining the cited calibrant compression law.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

scientific_validation.note: Validated directly against the complete free-access publisher article. No supplementary data file is listed; the official HTML exposes Tables 1 and 4-6 in full.

primary_source_check.finding: The source defines a three-free-parameter, error-weighted BM3 fit to all 7 Fe75 observations and gives the Eulerian equation, conventional-cell volume basis, exact sample composition, and quartz pressure calibration.

primary_data_check.finding: All 7 printed Fe75 lattice parameters, V/V0 values, simultaneous quartz volumes, reduced pressures, and parenthetical standard deviations are transcribed losslessly; Table 5's three blank Fe75 entries are not invented as observations.

independent_refit.objective: Effective-variance pressure residuals combining tabulated pressure and lattice-parameter standard deviations; the ambient pressure has no printed standard deviation.
independent_refit.conclusion: The independent refit recovers every published coefficient within its printed standard deviation.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Paragraphs 23-26; Tables 1 and 5-6; Figures 5-6.
parameter_provenance.equation: Paragraphs 25-26 and Figure 6: standard third-order Birch-Murnaghan EOS in the Eulerian finite-strain convention, with f=[(V0/V)^(2/3)-1]/2 and F=P/[3f(1+2f)^(5/2)].
parameter_provenance.V0: Paragraph 25: freely fitted V0=78.082(3) A^3 for the conventional cubic cell.
parameter_provenance.K0: Paragraph 25 and Table 6: freely fitted isothermal K0=151.3(6) GPa.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Paragraph 25 and Table 6: freely fitted K'=5.55(19).
parameter_provenance.reference_temperature: The article reports room/ambient temperature but no numeric kelvin value; 298 K is an explicit operational reference for this isothermal record.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Paragraphs 24-25 and Table 5: all 7 Fe75 rows, including the zero-pressure in-cell observation; three Table 5 pressure steps contain no Fe75 measurement and are not observations.
parameter_provenance.weighting: Paragraph 25: error-weighted three-parameter fit with EoSFIT; the table supplies row-wise sample-lattice and pressure standard deviations.
